title: fxv init command payload
description: Payload schema for the `fxv init` command's JSON output.

workspace_root.description: Absolute or relative path of the directory the workspace was created in.

repo_uri.description: URI of the repository the new workspace is connected to, or null for a --local-only workspace.

local_only.description: True when the workspace was created with --local-only and has no remote repository behind it.
